name: stripe
description: Stripe's legacy payment flows: creating Charges, the Sources API, redirectToCheckout and legacy Checkout.

statement: creating card payments with the Charges API is deprecated, and new integrations cannot use it
replacement: Checkout Sessions or the Payment Intents API (paymentIntents.create)

statement: the Sources API is deprecated and Stripe plans to remove it
replacement: the Payment Intents and Payment Methods APIs

statement: stripe.redirectToCheckout is no longer supported in Stripe.js as of the 2025-09-30 (Clover) release
replacement: redirect to the Checkout Session URL (window.location.href = session.url), or Payment Links

statement: checkout.js is the legacy version of Checkout, a modal that returns a token or a source
replacement: a Checkout Session created on the server, or Payment Links
